<!--
Bug reports follow the same prose-first style the project uses for
feature work, so AI coding agents and reviewers parse the body the
same way they parse a PRD. Write paragraphs, not checkbox grids.
Replace every guidance comment with the actual content.
-->

## Summary

<!--
One or two sentences naming the defect from the user's point of view.
Avoid framing the summary as a hypothesised cause; describe the
observed problem.
-->

## Reproduction

<!--
The steps that reliably reproduce the defect, written as prose or a
short numbered list. Include the surface (Conversation, Settings,
Onboarding), the entry state (e.g. fresh install, ProviderConfig
present, attachment of a given type), and the action taken.
-->

## Expected vs Actual

<!--
What you expected to happen, then what actually happened. Quote any
on-screen error text verbatim. If the defect produces a crash, paste
the relevant excerpt of the crash report here or link to it.
-->

## Environment

<!--
Device model, iOS version, app build, simulator vs physical device.
If the defect depends on a specific Provider Config, name the vendor
and model id (omit credentials).
-->

## Further Notes

<!--
Workarounds, related issues or ADRs, screenshots, recordings, or any
context that helps the agent or maintainer reproduce and triage the
defect.
-->
